component_findings.build_execute: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-1--typescript): Microsoft has released TypeScript 7.0, featuring a native compiler that improves build speeds by 8x to 12x.
component_findings.diagnostic_quality: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-1--typescript): Jest and Vitest are both mature, actively maintained test runners with TypeScript-native support; VS Code and Node.js ship first-party debugging support; the build-tool ecosystem (webpack, Vite, esbuild, Rollup, swc, Rspack) is unusually broad and mature. Minor deduction because TypeScript 7.0 initially shipped without a stable programmatic compiler API, a temporary integration gap for tools that hook the compiler directly.
component_findings.docs_package: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-1--typescript): 0-100 score = sum of four 0-25 sub-scores covering the core toolchain a working developer needs day-to-day: (1) official/primary compiler-or-runtime toolchain maturity and active maintenance, (2) formatter availability/adoption of a standard tool, (3) linter availability/adoption of a standard tool, (4) test runner + debugger + build-tool integration maturity. Same four sub-checks and same source types (official docs, release notes, and independent 2026 comparison articles) are to be used for every language.
